description: Traceloop @workflow calling a @task that makes one OpenAI chat completion, with session, user, and one other association property.
notes: TRACELOOP_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so message content and workflow input and output are recorded on spans. TRACELOOP_METRICS_ENABLED is false and TRACELOOP_LOGGING_ENABLED is false. Traceloop.init sets api_endpoint to the receiver base URL, disables batching, passes telemetry_enabled false, and enables only the OpenAI instrument. The SDK then appends /v1/traces and exports over HTTP. In 0.62.4 the telemetry_enabled parameter is unused: there is no posthog client and no TRACELOOP_TELEMETRY variable. ThreadingInstrumentor is always enabled and emitted no spans. Image upload runs only for an image span, and this call has none. The capture is weather_report.workflow, lookup_weather.task, and openai.chat. Association properties session_id, user_id, and feature are on all three, with traceloop.workflow.name weather_report. Token counts are copied: input 24, output 12, cache_read 8, reasoning 0. gen_ai.openai.api_base is the public host https://api.openai.com/v1/. The workflow scope traceloop.tracer carries no version.

message.text: It is 18 °C and sunny in Paris.
